recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the old partOf name or remove current Account.balance under FHIR-12685; future relationship or balance changes should be handled under the later targeted Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-12685 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add Account.partOf 0..1 Reference(Account), allowing child Accounts to point to a parent Account, and to remove the old Account.balance so linked-account balance effects did not need to be specified.
initial_application: Git commit 31a1a93cd9d77a9c85124688f199fb32ffd3b571 explicitly applied GF#12685 by adding Account.partOf to the historical Account spreadsheet source and removing Account.balance from the spreadsheet, examples, and balance search parameter. Later source rework commits carried the applied partOf element into the XML StructureDefinition source before later Account relationship issues changed the representation.
additional_context: Account is active in source/fhir.ini. The current R6 source maps R4 Account.partOf to Account.parent, defines Account.parent as a 0..1 Reference(Account), and provides a matching Account-parent search parameter. Later final Account issues explain the differences from the literal seed wording: FHIR-20994 and FHIR-20997 evolved parent and non-parent relationships, FHIR-44682 replaced relatedAccount with Account.parent and Account.guarantor.account, and FHIR-20972 reintroduced calculated Account.balance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current Account model preserves the seed's child-to-parent linkage semantics, and removing current Account.balance would contradict later Published/Applied decisions.
